top_signals.title: Russell Weighs Letting Growth Stocks Claim Up to 60% in Indexes
top_signals.summary: For almost four decades, FTSE Russell has divided the market value of stocks in its benchmarks evenly between growth companies prized for their earnings potential and value stocks favored for their relatively cheap prices. Now, as technology giants increasingly dominate the market, the index provider is reconsidering that 50/50 split.
